DEDICATION Prologue Write the prologue covering the fallen stuff people need to know before  comtinuing until he was in his possession.   ONE In Search Of Lord Seer Rogan sat upon the throne of judgement the deep purple robes of his office wrapped around his shoulders like armor as he stared down the four pathetic men now kneeling before him. “You are charged with the theft of the Lord Seers food stock and then the abandonment of your post, how do you plead” Lor i c read from the parchment held in his hand. The four men having taken food to feed their families and then taken it to them during the time they were supposed to be working the fields for the Empress. The Lord Seer had instituted rationing despite the commoners complaints of starvation to ensure he could send more food stock to the troops, he would not tolerate the whining and complaining of the common people  who’s  only reason for existing was to serve him and by serving him , the Empress. The fact that he let them eat at all should be a reason to celebrate he thought, his jaw clenching in anger as his eyes bore into the four men. “Pathetic, how dare you steal from me” Rogan said none of the men daring to make eye contact with him.  He stood from the throne taking a step down closer to these men. “But, you have stated that your families are too large for the small amount of food I give you, is this correct?” he asked the four men, his tone almost gentle and finally the men looked up and Rogan could see hope in  there  eyes. All  four nodded. “Yes my lord, we all have multiple children, what you offer barely feeds the adults and our children cry from starvation, we did not mean any disrespect towards you lord, we only wish to take care of our children” the man on the left proclaimed and Rogan smiled at him. “I can understand this, Lor i c” he called to his assistant who nodded at him. “Have the children executed and display the bodies in the courtyard as an example of what happens when you steal from me” he said , the men erupted into screams of protest, the man who spoke his face twisted in anger launched himself at the Lord Seer. “Pathetic” he said as he raised his hand calling forth the power as the man stopped four feet from the Lord Seer, his body hanging in the air.  “I would kill you for your insolence, but I feel letting you live to be a worst punishment” he said and then with a flick of his hand sent the man crashing against the back stone wall, hard enough to knock him out, but not hard enough to kill him. The men were taken out as the soldiers were given their orders to kill the children, they too left the hall, leaving only Rogan and Lor i c left. “My Lord” he heard Lor i c call and with a sigh turned towards his assistant. “What is it Lor i c?” Rogan asked gently, but he could see the young man’s face, the pain and horror at ordering the death of the children.  He knew the young man was going to balk at this and he understood, so Rogan walked over and put his arm around the young man “ Its  important we quash all resistance Lor i c, this will ensure we have no more problems and that our commoners stay in line, allowing us to concentrate on  whats   important, we have entire species to save my young assistant. When this is done you will be celebrated for your strength and will to do what was  nessescary ” he said gently to the young man. Lor i c lowered his eyes nodding to his Lord. “Of course, my Lord” he whispered trying to hide the tears that streamed down his face. “Do we have any more of these today?”  Rogan asked waving his hand at the large room used as a court and Lor i c shook his head “No My Lord, that was the last” he finished and Rogan squeezed the young man’s shoulder reassuringly “Take the rest of the day Lor i c, rest, I will see you tomorrow” he whispered to him and the young man walked off Leaving Rogan alone in the room.  He smiled as he looked at the area, he used to dispense justice, this room defined his reign and what happened here would help write the story of his dedication to humanity and  to saving it he thought his eyes shone like that of a true believer. Standing there he soaked in the power that surrounded the room. Power was a drug and he felt a rush when dispensing it he mused. These people were a means to an end, the Empress had spent years showing him the true purpose of the common people were to serve the crown and in doing so becoming the foundation of a great empire.  He understood this, Rogan lived it and he would ensure that his people would work to serve him and sometimes that meant that some would have to be made an example of, by showing them that he would punish any  devation  from his orders without mercy, he would create a smooth running machine that would supply the armies and in doing so make him the envy of the chosen 12. Rogan left  the room, the echo of a smile still on his face as he entered the private quarters. As he began to gently remove the purple robe, appreciating the way the soft fabric felt as he ran his hand over it, folding the robe and placing it in the closet a light knock came at the door.  With a sigh he closed the closet and turned “Come in” he said and Captain Postric entered the small chambers that Rogan now called his own. “Sir, the two prisoners are talking and we might have some information that you would be interested in” he stated standing at attention as he always did in Rogan’s presence, it was one of the reasons that Rogan enjoyed having the captain around, the man understood his place and showed respect to those above him. Rogan nodded “Which prisoners?” he asked trying to remember what he had asked the other man to do, it was important he did remember that, but there was so much to do in getting a territory  oraganized .  “The messenger and the mage my lord” he stated, and Rogan remembered. “Let’s go at once” he said heading out the door ahead of the captain, if these two men were indeed talking then they could tell him the location of the one the Empress sought, and that information was worth its weight in gold he thought. He rapidly walked down the hall coming to the door that led below, throwing it open the smell of blood and body odor hit him and the Lord Seer almost lost his lunch, god it stank he thought stepping back. Postric was there, handing him an orange and a cloth “Here my lord, this will help” he said , Rogan looking doubtful, but taking the two items, placing the cloth to his face the heavy scent of orange overpowered any other as he  entered the stairs and made his way below.  The lower level was dark and damp, Rogan doing his best not to  tough  the wet and slimy stone as he  desvended  the slick steps, reaching the bottom he waited for  postric  to go ahead of him. Walking down the narrow halls, past the heavy wooden doors of the dungeon area, that was one thing he  vould  appreciate about Galen, the man had taken care to create the perfect place to house and torture those who displeased the crown. Rogan, holding his breath, squeezed more of the orange onto the cloth, replacing it and taking a deep breath. This was no place for a lord he thought. Captain Postric stopped at one of the doors and opening it waited for Rogan to enter.  The Lord saw the two men, hanging naked in the center of the small  cell ,  blood dripping from fresh wounds on  there  torso. Postric had done a  thourough  job he thought, appreciating the layer upon layer of marks on these men, both had been down here for over a week and the Captain had taken care to inflict damage and then move to another area until the first one was healed, allowing him to inflict fresh pain without killing or  bleeding these men out.  Walking In the captain prodded the first one, Rogan looked and spotted the telltale tattoo of a mage, which explained the crystal harness around his  waste , grounding out his ability to use his gift Rogan thought approvingly. “Tell the Lord Seer what you told me” Postric yelled prodding the man again. The Mage stirred, finally coming awake after a few more rough prods from the Captain. “Tell him what you told me”  Potric  repeated. Rogan could see the unfocused eyes, this man had been  pushed to the edge, his mind almost broken he thought.  “A man, a stranger came into my shop with a woman, the woman was known to me, he was peculiar so without his knowledge I used a power stone and tested his ability, he was powerful my lord, but had no markings of a mage” the man mumbled, struggling through the words and finally getting them out. Rogan took another step forward “Who was this man?” he asked but the mage had passed out yet again, with a nod to  postric  the captain began to prod the prisoner again until he stirred “Tell the lord the name of this man” the captain yelled “Marcus my lord, the woman called him Marcus” he said.  Then a groan came from the other side of the room, Rogan turning to  reguard  the messenger,  Veric , that was his name “Messenger Veric, what do you know of this Marcus?” he asked but the Messenger didn’t speak just stood staring at Rogan, he could see the hate in the Messengers eyes and smiled. Yes of course he would despise him he thought. Postric began to walk towards the prisoner but Rogan held up a hand, this one was his he thought. Summoning his power, he began to  excert  pressure on the man’s groin, slowly increasing it until the man began to scream and howl, his body squirming as he tried to get away from the pain. “Yes Messenger, I can do this all day, you will tell me what I want to know or this will continue” Rogan purred, enjoying the moment, watching the man, helpless in agony that only Rogan could stop, it was power at its truest form he thought still smiling as the man howled louder.  Eventually the Messenger told him  everything, how he had met Marcus what they had talked about and where he had said he was from. Rogan left the dungeon and ascended back to the keep proper a victorious smile on his face as he entered his quarters once  againt  to pack. It took almost two hours to  orgnanize  the guards and prepare the convoy before Rogan stood there, giving his final orders to Lor i c. “Sir, I still think you should allow us to find this man, your needed here Postric stated, his tone barely hiding the annoyance at having the Lord Seer usurp his authority on this matter. Rogan simply smiled, he liked Postric but that would only get this man so far if he did not turn his attitude around, his  authorty  was only that which Rogan gave him, the man needed to be reminded of that one in a while, and this was the perfect time. “Captain Postric, I will take these men and hunt down the fugitive myself, this is not a man you could stop, in fact if he wanted  to ,  he would simply kill you with a  a  thought” Rogan finished. “I am the only one here who will have the ability to bring him down and capture him so that we may transport him to the Empress, did you prepare the mage belt?” he asked. The Captain presenting the box to the lord Seer. Rogan had never had to wear one, of course until recently his powers wouldn’t have been a threat to anyone. But he had seen them work, it had the ability to ground out the power that a Mage gathered to themselves before sending it out as a spell or force of will.  He would incapacitate this Marcus and then once he put the belt on him, put him in the caged cart they were bringing, finally delivering him to the Empress personally. The rewards he would  receive from his Empress would be the envy of the chosen he knew. Smiling he started out with the precession. “Where to first sir, Postric asked as he rode next to the lord Seer, Rogan smiling as he thought about his quarry and the rewards that were in store for him. “The farm, where he lived with the woman” he said. Closing his eyes Rogan reached out with his power, finding the two Screamers as they canvassed the woods, they had the ability to  pickup  power and though it had been quite a while since Marcus had been there, he had hoped the two of them still might find a trail that would tell them where he had gone. If not, then they would use traditional methods until they got close enough. But once they did and once, the two screamers that served him picked up the trail of the Mage they would not stop until he was found. The group rode towards the remnants of the farm.  Rogan looked over the derelict building that stood stalwart and charred, it was an unremarkable piece of property he thought as he surveyed the dilapidated barn and animal pens, anything of value having been pilfered well before his taking over the territory. “What happened here Captain” he asked as Postric had his men survey the property looking for any clues that might have been left either as to the life he had lived or to his eventual evacuation of it. They had come up with nothing, nor had they been able to find anything more  then  a  biline  as to the death of six collectors the day the building burned. “I fear we may never know my lord” Postric said coming back after dismissing his men to their horses. “I am not sure what we do now as there is no indication where this Marcus went once,  he left here” he finished knowing his words wouldn’t please the Lord Seer. Rogan simple smiled, his eyes closed, what  postric  didn’t know was that a faint trail had been found and the screamers were heading south looking for more. The group headed south, finding only a few abandoned camps and no sign that they had come this way. Rogan stayed out for almost two weeks before returning unsuccessfully to his keep. Rogan  could not sleep nor could he eat, dammit he thought he had been so close to finding the man who the Empress had sought.  On the third day however, things changed. Rogan had been eating breakfast when the door burst open “What is the meaning of this” he said annoyed at the interruption as a man covered with the dirt of riding long distance, entered the room “ Im  sorry my Lord, a letter from the Empress” he said , bowing and handing Rogan a sealed parchment.  Taking the letter, he dismissed the rider and quickly opened the letter, He read through it twice, the smile returning to his face as he did. “Lor i c, prepare my horse, I am leaving, tell captain Postric I wish four of his best soldiers to ride with me” he yelled, getting up the unfinished breakfast forgotten as he quickly dressed and prepared to leave. Lor i c entered the room “My Lord?” he said, not understanding what his Lord was doing, he had just returned , what could have caused him to want to leave again he wondered, watching as an Agitated Lord Seer, ransacked the room looking for items he threw into the leather sack on the bed. “He has left the Order and heading North Lor i c, he will pass by here and I mean to capture him” Rogan  said, moving the young man as he walked past him, heading for the main doors and to the stables.  “You are in charge again, I hope to be gone only a week, prepare the  dungeion , when I  return  I will be bringing my prisoner here” he said excitedly. Lor i c Nodded “My Lord, how do we know this?” he asked, who could have passed this information onto him he wondered. Rogan stopped turning to look at his assistant the smile still on his face. “Lord Aster, the head of the Order, hoping to spare them the wrath of the Empress, the fool things by giving up Marcus he will be able to keep his order, he doesn’t know the Empress has already dispatched troops to capture the order” he said laughing as if the situation was at all humorous.  Rogan and his troops rode out quickly heading towards the south. “We will find somewhere to wait for my quarry, we ride for a day and then secure a farm or inn, from there we will send out scouts until he is spotted, no one will engage him, he is mine” Ordered Rogan as they rode. Closing his eyes, he passed his orders to the Screamers as they slunk through the woods nearby, Engage him, secure him, run him down, but don’t kill him he thought to the screamers and felt the frustration of being robbed of the murder of anyone, they were simple creatures who’s primal thoughts were easily understood he thought.  TWO Going Home Shielding his eyes from the bright sun, Nero surveyed the fields that stretched as far as the eye could see, it had been many years since he had traveled from Aurtus’s Keep, the headquarters of his order and the place he had begun his journey as an  embassador  of the Revered  Emisarry . He had forgotten how beautiful this territory could be, he had been resident in the keep of his small village for too long he reflected as he smiled over the sun-bathed fields of wheat and cotton that stretched out towards the mountains in the distance.  Nero wasn’t worried about getting too lost, the mountains were still in front of him and they had been at his back all those years ago, he was headed in the correct direction at least he thought he was , mounting his horse he easily found the market road the farmers would use to head into town and sell there harvest. Following the road, he passed farm after farm the small complexes busy as people worked the fields and took care of the animals that would make them money and feed them for the winter. There was no more noble pursuit Nero thought smiling as he passed men herding cows into a field. When he had started his quest he had been worried and vexed that the land might be under threat, but having passed the last week, seeing people working as usual and the land still the  breataking  beauty he remembered, he had  begun to forget the urgency and horror that he and the mage had witnessed causing them to report to  there  perspective Order’s. Korlin and he had split ways a week ago, the Mage heading towards the east to the Order that he served. While Nero continued south towards the range of mountains that stretched across his current horizon. He had been feeling more relieved the further he rode, smiling as he followed the farmers fence, knowing this would lead him to town, he came over a ridge and the smile died on his face.  Surveying the area in front of him, he could see the smoke pillars rising into the sky, squinting he saw the wall of the village a mile out, but something wasn’t right, the smoke  pire’s  were coming from within the wall he thought. No that couldn’t be  right ,  maybe they are simply clear cutting he thought, speeding up the horse as he rode. This is  deja   vue  he thought pushing his legs faster as he tried to get to the small village that like others he had  seen ,  even recently stood burning. “What is she hoping to prove” he asked no one , anger replacing the worry the Empress had gone too far, her mages had gone too far he reflected finally making it to the gate of the village, stopping short he soon realized that there was no reason to have bothered. Looking at the courtyard of the village a scaffolding had been erected and the pile of bodies next to those still left hanging told the story, the troops seeing this village as uncontrollable had hung the entire residents. Nero pulled off the cloak he wore to combat the cold evenings covering the small body of the child who looked no more  then  four. What could a  four year old  have possibly done to threaten these men of  war he thought, the tears streaming down his face. Nero let out a scream of rage as these faces were added to the others that now made his consciousness home. “How dare you” he screamed to the sky “Why wouldn’t you save this child, or this child, or this one” he said pointing out the small limp bodies strewn between those of the adults. “What could we have ever possibly done to earn the displeasure so severe that these children had to pay the price” screaming he moved around searching the sky, looking for any sign that he could be heard. The Empress had gone too far, she had gotten the mages to aid her. How many villages he wondered were out there just like this, that they had decided to make an example of. Decided the young and the innocent needed to die to fuel the cause they used to motivate themselves to these means.  Whats  ends could  possible  be worth this he wondered. Tears now freely streaming down his face.  Nero dropped to his knees, surrounded by the corpses of these people who did nothing to offend the gods, nothing to spurn them, these bodies who until recently were the people who filled the keep praying to Aurtus, to ask for good crops of healthy children. “Aurtus, I don’t understand how you can do this, these people who have done nothing to you, nor to the gods you serve. How can the Empress have such a hold, I truly understand bad things happen? But this is too much my Lord, this is too much” he prayed pleading to the man he had dedicated his life to serve.  But no answer came, no sign to show him the gods were listening or that Aurtus himself had  heard his prayer, so he stayed there on his knees until his legs went numb. Getting up his legs almost locked in place he finally began the process of burying the people of this village, to ensure they would have a proper burial, with each strike of the shovel into the dirt his hatred of the Empress and her mages grew, the fire stoked with the price of the dead. Nero vowed at that moment to not stop until the woman was dead, until the mages that served her were all dead, this was not the first time that mages had sought control, the church had been there to stop them and since that time they had become complacent, they no longer fielded a standing army, no longer had the weapons or the knowledge to combat those with the gift. Nero resolved to change that to the gods as his witness they would not become complacent again.  It began to dawn on him that maybe the punishment for these people wasn’t about what they had done, but instead what the church had. If his church had not disbanded the army, become lazy and complacent they could have moved against the Empress, stopped her before these horrible things had happened. But as of now, the church was as powerless as that child that now lay dead and cold on the ground he thought.  “Is that what this is my Lord, punishment for us, for those who dedicated ourselves to lead and protect these people. Is this our fault?” he asked standing in the shallow hole, his clothes covered with dirt as le leaned on the old shovel and considered this. For close to an hour he stood there , eyes closed as he thought about all he had seen and experienced and knew, knew deep in his heart that his people, the leader of the flock of  those who  saught  guidance from the  Emisarry  could have been the champions who prevented this instead of victims, helpless and running.  It took Nero most of the night and half the next day to bury the bodies of these villagers, but he did it , without stopping, without rest and when he was done, he stood over the lumps of dirt that now held the village he stood in and said the words blessing  there  souls and asking Aurtus to receive them. Once done he rested, eating what little food he had before setting off towards Aurtus’s keep. His mind full of the contemplative thoughts of the last day. He would talk to the Lord Reagent, it was possible he could assign Nero to build the army back up, to again search the great library for the knowledge to train the soldiers and outfit them with the gear protecting them from the mages.  As the mountains grew larger the seed of hate that had nestled into his belly began to grow, the fertilizer of subjugation and death the fertilizer used so that by the time he reached the base of rock that held his orders keep, the seed had grown into a sturdy tree dripping with the blood of those slain at the hands of the Empress and her soldiers. Mages he thought Mages are the problem they give license to this travesty, they are the reason we find ourselves once again bathed in the blood of innocent people, farmers and tradesman who lived a simple existence so that the Empress may try to wrestle a little more power and a little more territory for her own hubris his mind continued. Climbing up the mountain trail towards the lights of the keep that loomed over the fields below he was so lost in his thoughts that he almost ran directly into a platoon of Empress’s soldiers  camped near the base of the tall mountain. He quietly circled the encampment, using the rocks and brush as cover, from the look of the camp they had been there a while and did not look like they were going to be leaving any time soon he reflected as he saw the half completed wood buildings of bunk houses that had begun to be erected.  He carefully made his way up until he finally stood outside the large keep, watching as soldiers ran patrols around the property. The guards out front no longer wore the sword design of the Aurtus protectorate but instead had the golden lioness of the  Empresss  guard. Nero knew the castle well and circled around the old stone building,  finaly  reaching near the rear of the structure he found what he was looking for , completely unguarded was the coal entrance, a portal added in later years to make it easier to bring coal and wood directly into the kitchen area of the old stone hearth, Nero smiled as he noticed that even the patrols seemed to ignore the door altogether.  Since the door actually opened into a storage area, only those who had to carry the wood into the kitchen, knew that the large storage shelf at the back would swing in and open into the side chamber in the large  complexs  kitchen. The initiates and young  messeners  used to joke calling it the “secret entrance” but now Nero thanked Aurtus that it had been so built. He waited until the next patrol passed and then sprinted to the building, once there he threw open the building, breathing a sigh of relief when the iron lever gave easily, no lock or bar blocking and securing it. Closing the door behind him, he left his way around the old  store room, but at the back he could see the light through the planks in back of the storage shelves, it took him almost ten minutes to feel around and find the latch that  aloud  the shelf to swing and winced as it creaked lightly as he pushed against the shelf , swinging it inward and slipping into the kitchen.  At this hour the kitchen was empty as it was well beyond dinner and breakfast wouldn’t start for a good few hours. He had a small window to slip in and out before he would be stuck within the old keep for the day. Feeling the time pressure, he quickly moved out of the kitchen and made his way along the dark hall to the servant’s staircase of the castle. He knew the patrols would use the main stairs and patrol the main foyer, since the servants quarters and staircases were well within the building and only one entrance allowed the servants to enter the complex into the servants rooms the guards didn’t waste soldiers on guarding it directly, instead opting to keep a guard on the  exterioir  door and anyplace that the servants areas intersected with the main complex.  He made it up the stairs and down another hall, coming to the door that would lead him into the outer foyer of the Lord Reagents Room. But he froze as he approached the door, outside sat a sleeping soldier. He stood there looking at the soldier, he didn’t know  wether  to flee, hide or continue and for a few moments stood there frozen in indecision. After a few moments Nero was  embolded  by the slow rising and lowering of the young soldier’s chest as he slept deeply. Carefully he approached, coming to stand next to the young soldier as he  dreamd  about his love, or some  wonderful adventure. Nero slowly opened the door, stopping only one as the soldier shifted in his seat. The messenger almost bolted then but the noise would have surely woken the soldier. So, there he stood waiting until he settled down and began breathing deeply once again.  Finishing  openin  the door he stepped through, not quite closing it in case he had to leave quickly. The door opened into the receiving chamber for the Lord Reagent the plush ornate carpet and wall decorations meant to show the status of the man you were about to meet. Nero could make out the high-quality mahogany receiving couches and tables as well as the marble top of the coffee table. Each end table had an ornate gold crystal lamp. He quietly walked across the room and slowly opened the door to the Lord Reagents private chamber.  Entering the main quarters of Lord  Alber  Corinth, current Lord Reagent of the Church of Wic Nero was nervous to be in the presence of Aurtus’s own emissary on earth. “Lord Corinth, My Lord are you here” he whispered. A groan came from the bed as Nero watched someone shift under the ornate red velvet covers. Walking over he came to find a sweating and pale Lord Corinth, barely conscious laying in the expensive bed. Something didn’t look right he thought and peeled back the blanket, underneath the Lord  Regeant  was still in his robes of office, but something didn’t look right and at first Nero nearly missed the wound in his  stomack  because of the deep red robes the man wore.  But then he saw it, the wound looks mortal and from the demeanor of his Lord Reagent, the  man did not have long to live. “My Lord” Nero hissed trying to get the man to wake even for a moment. To have him die after Nero had come all this way would be a miserable way to fail the self-imposed mission. Corinth opened his eyes, though they were not focused “Who, wo is there” the slurred voice came. They must have drugged him, or his loss of blood was affecting his mind. Nero wasn’t sure, he was not trained as doctor and the limited knowledge he had in first aid would be no help here. Mostly the young  Messener  just felt helpless as he tried to get the old man to focus. “ Its  Messenger Nero..” he began and then suddenly the eyes focused, Corinth looked directly at him, his eyes going wide “Nero, it is you, how did you get in here,  nevermind  Listen , the Empress has taken the keep, they hoped to keep me around to ensure that no one was  suspicios , however I managed to get a letter out to my counterpart in Dever , we received a reply that basically said, there was nothing they could do, the soldiers found the reply and realizing what I had done, well one stabbed me” he said looking down at his robes, what little energy he had seemed to be fading as his eyes began to  swimp  out of focus. “He stabbed me” he said again as if unable to believe someone would do that. “No help, no help is coming” he  continued  and that realization seemed to seal the old man’s fate and he slumped unconscious. The Empress had killed the Lord Reagent, had tried to take out the religion that supported this land. He didn’t know if  dever  would forward the request for assistance to Turen, to the main keep of Wic where the Emissary of Aurtus currently called home,  But he wouldn’t dare hope that Turen or  Dever  would lend  there  soldier to safe  them ,  he knew the politics involved, there would be censure and arguments but no soldiers would enter Vicor because they were all along the border waiting for the Empress to invade. Everyone knew it was coming, only a matter of when he thought. He sat there for a long time wondering what to do finally he spotted Lord Corinth’s hand and there upon it was the ring of office, the ring that made him the authority of the church in Vicor. Nero knew he didn’t have long but paused as he thought about what to do , there were a lot  og  messengers older and more experienced, but the leadership of the religion was here, or had been here, if the Lord Reagent was dead, then here was no reason to keep them around. Someone had to take control, had to become the head of the order lest the order be lost. With a deep sigh and a small prayer. Nero worked the ring off of the finger of the old man, during the process Corinth had awoken again, after a moment he realized what Nero was trying to do , he first tried to pull away but he was weak and Nero held him still as he continued to work off the ring, the man , not able to do anything simply lay there crying. He knew that if Nero was taking the ring, they he thought him dead. Finally, the large gold ring came free and Nero whispered a small blessing for the man before slipping the ring into his pocket and retreating back into the receiving room. He slipped past the still sleeping guard and down the hall. It took him only about five minutes to exit the keep, with no sign of the patrol he rushed across the open ground making the brush before he heard the heavy footfalls signaling the approach of the  sguard  patrol.  He sped away from the keep, making his way north to rendezvous with Korlin it is possible that he may have had better success finding help within the mages order. He smiled wryly as he thought of the irony of Mages helping get rid of other mages, hell he wasn’t convinced that the mages who served the Empress weren’t with the order he thought. Was it possible that the order was in on it, that the Empress had made a deal with the once secretive leaders of the Mages order he wondered? Magic in the land had become scarce and those with it were nowhere near as powerful as in the past, but the stories he had heard of the ones serving the Empress were like the mages of old. They had power and used it easily to demonstrate their superiority, was this the inevitable outcome of the church leaving the mages alive, had the founders of the order who had hunted them down been right he wondered.  These where the thoughts that plagued his mind the further, he rode, heading north, maybe Korlin would find answers, maybe he would find help. THE END EPILOGUE Q 1 Holy Ruler “We return this land to order and prosperity, we bring to it a balanced rule, a stewardship until such time that we are able to return a ruler who is worthy of your obedience, we return the nobility to  there  lands and bring back the rules and dictates of the  Emporer , the true ruler of this land. We the  Messenger    s  of Aurtus will ensure continuity until a new  Emporer  or Empress is found.” The Lord Reagent announced to the gathered people of Vicor, the entire commons were packed with nobles and common alike as a cheer rose up to greet his words. The Lord Reagent spoke from the balcony of the palace where the church now ruled.  Nero had returned prosperity, freed the children and shutdown the tower. Things were beginning to look like they would come back to normal Marcus thought leaning in the doorway and watching the speech.  Soldiers walked by eyeing his clothing, the outlook towards mages had not improved but at the same time the church had not spoken of the agreement, or their intentions. Marcus hoped for the best and sighed as he turned back towards the room where His friends sat Corliss now the Lord Adjudicator of the new Wardens stood resplendent in her new leather armor complete with the crest of the wardens emblazoned upon it, Uri having retired  to live in peace with the Silvan’s , Dara, Maelen and Patrice now sat around the small table listening as the Reagent continued to speak of prosperity and peace.  “So, what’s next?” Maelen asked looking towards Marcus who shifted uncomfortably his friend had seen the packed back by the door and knew what that meant. “I am heading North, there is a lot to see and this place holds too many bad memories for now” he said and could see Dara’s face fall. “Your leaving?” she asked coming over to him and Marcus took the young mage by the shoulders. “There is something out there, something I can’t explain the Empress said some things to me that leads me to believe she saw it too” he said lowly “I am going to find out what I can, I will be back, but there is a lot that I need to find out” he finished.  The speech ended to applause and Marcus nodded to his friends. Corliss came over first “Look me up when you come back Marcus, a lot of  whats  going on today is because of you, for that you have my thanks” she said giving him a hug and then stepping back. Maelen walked him out “Where will you go, back to the  Silvan’s ? ” he asked walking with his friend as he left the small house and headed towards the stables. Marcus was quiet for a few minutes and then looked at his friend “Not sure, I think I am going to find out what else is out there,  Durass  spoke of other people further north, I want to see if they might know something about these dreams” he said. His friend was quiet for a long time. “When you come back, we should have the order back, if the new ruler allows it” he said wincing, knowing how Nero felt about the mages.  “Take care my friend, I will see you when I get back” Marcus said giving his friend a hug and then walking on, leaving Maelen looking after him as Marcus mounted the large cat that stood outside the stables , since the stable boy wouldn’t go near the large animal.  He rode out of the capital and headed north, looking back at the capital he lowered his head and whispered a small prayer for his friends and then turned heading into the setting sun.
